calls.statement:
SELECT count(*) AS rows_, count(DISTINCT e.exposure_id) AS dist_exp, count(DISTINCT e.member_key) AS dist_keys, count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS dist_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN e.delivered THEN m.member_id END) AS delivered_members,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN h.member_id IS NOT NULL THEN m.member_id END) AS holdout_overlap,
 count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN m.marketing_consent THEN NULL ELSE m.member_id END) AS noconsent_members,
 min(e.contact_ts_utc) AS mn, max(e.contact_ts_utc) AS mx,
 string_agg(DISTINCT e.contact_channel, ',') AS chans,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_rows,
 (SELECT count(DISTINCT member_id) FROM campaign_holdout WHERE campaign_id=19) AS holdout_members
FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
LEFT JOIN campaign_holdout h ON h.campaign_id = e.campaign_id AND h.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE e.campaign_id = 19

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id
    FROM fact_campaign_exposure e
    JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key
    WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
),
web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, status,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
),
lines AS (
    SELECT m.member_id, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.gross_amount, f.channel_code, s.store_id,
           COALESCE(CASE WHEN w.status IN ('delivered','collected') THEN w.dispatch_date END, CASE WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN NULL ELSE f.sale_date END) AS eff_date
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_member m  ON m.member_key = f.member_key
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM targeted) AS contacted_members,
       count(DISTINCT l.member_id) AS buying_members,
       count(*) AS line_cnt, count(DISTINCT l.sales_line_id) AS dist_lines,
       sum(l.net_amount) AS net_before_returns,
       sum(CASE WHEN l.store_id=900 THEN l.net_amount END) AS web_part,
       sum(l.gross_amount) AS gross
FROM lines l JOIN targeted t USING (member_id)
WHERE l.eff_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'

calls.statement:
SELECT
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT receipt_id, line_no FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05' GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_lines,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05' GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*)>1)) AS dup_ids,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key LEFT JOIN fact_web_order w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE s.store_id=900 AND w.web_order_id IS NULL AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-25' AND DATE '2026-06-05') AS web_lines_no_order,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=f.member_key WHERE f.member_key IS NOT NULL AND m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan_member_keys,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_campaign_exposure e LEFT JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key=e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id=19 AND m.member_key IS NULL) AS orphan_exposure,
 (SELECT max(sale_date) FROM fact_sales_line) AS max_sale,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status='processing' AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-05-25') AS processing_old,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM fact_web_order w WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected') AND dispatch_ts_utc IS NULL) AS no_dispatch

calls.statement:
WITH targeted AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.member_id FROM fact_campaign_exposure e JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = e.member_key WHERE e.campaign_id = 19
)
SELECT count(DISTINCT m.member_id) AS returning_members, sum(r.refund_net) AS refunds_net
FROM fact_return_line r
JOIN dim_member m ON m.member_key = r.member_key
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
JOIN targeted t ON t.member_id = m.member_id
WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-05-04' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
